reviews.text:
I recently hired Ashcraft Pools for a complete pool renovation at my home in Fort Worth, Texas, and I’m beyond thrilled with the results! Curtis and his team transformed our outdated pool into a stunning, modern oasis, and the entire experience was top-notch from start to finish.

Curtis was fantastic during the initial consultation. He listened to our needs, offered creative ideas to update the pool’s design, and explained the renovation process clearly, including timelines and costs. His expertise gave us confidence in choosing Ashcraft Pools. The crew was professional, punctual, and kept our backyard tidy throughout the project, which was a huge plus.

The renovation itself is impeccable—new tiling, updated lighting, and energy-efficient equipment have completely elevated our pool. Curtis even suggested a sleek water feature that’s now our favorite part! The project was completed on schedule, and Curtis followed up to ensure everything was perfect.

Ashcraft Pools’ attention to detail and customer service are unmatched. If you need a pool renovation in Fort Worth, Curtis and his team are the best in the business. Highly recommend them for turning your pool into a backyard masterpiece!
reviews.author: Jerico Bailleu

reviews.text: Curtis is fantastic.  We’ve utilized his services for almost three years now.  He’s incredibly knowledgeable and has saved the day for us more times than we can count.  He does great work at reasonable rates and is always there to answer questions for us.  We’re really thankful to have found him. Thanks for everything, Curtis!
reviews.author: Jessica Evans

reviews.text: This is the second time I needed help repairing my pool heater and so thankful I kept Curtis Ashcroft’s phone number. Both times he arrived when he said he would, diagnosed the problem and fixed the issue efficiently. The first time was a manifold replacement and I bought the part online and he installed. The second time I needed a new control board and sensor.. Curtis was nothing but exceptional and provided great value for the service. You cannot go wrong having him come out. He’s fair and honest and great at what he does. Thanks Curtis.
reviews.author: Sam Akins

reviews.text: We needed a pool replaster and chose Curtis simply because he explained the process in great detail showing his vast knowledge pool resurfacing. He was on sight on and off during the whole process. His crews were great and when they were finished all demolition and replaster waste was COPLETELY cleaned up and removed. Curtis and his crew did a great job.
reviews.author: Sam Merenda

reviews.text: I have used Curtis for close to 7 years now for my pool cleaning and maintenance. I never have to worry about anything related to my pool thanks to his company. I always feel like my pool and my business are a top priority. Can not recommend him enough. Truly the best
reviews.author: Woodhill Farm

reviews.text: Curtis a d his crew came out and did a re-tile and modified our spillway.  They were very professional.  The job was done in a very timely manner and I would recommend Curtis to anyone that is in need of work done on their pool.

reviews.text: He came the same day, was honest, very knowledgeable and price was affordable! He got our problem resolved! Our pool looks great! Highly recommend Curtis Ashcraft Pool Service!
